theme: Physical manufacture and use evidence for a bounded Harappa tablet series
question: Which physical manufacture, grouping and use relations does the primary publication establish for H-2218–H-2239?
outcome: The complete 22-object series has a local register of 308 source-qualified assertions. Published microscopic examination reports common cutting direction and within-character stroke order across at least three engravers. The inherited recovery split is sixteen in a clump, two nearby and four scattered, all in secondary debris. Six physical-use fields remain unreported for these objects in the bounded chapter, yielding 132 unknown assertions. No objects or registration joins are newly discovered. The proposed pouch, ended utility and direct-reading intent remain attributed interpretations. Worn terracotta examples in Figure 3 are kept separate from this incised steatite block. No confirmation or new significance test was accessed and no conjecture credence changed.
challenge: An existing registration frame can appear to supply operational evidence when published interpretations or wear from another material class are transferred to its members. The source does not resolve one-time versus accumulated production, and no registered impression, attachment or allotment was recovered in this chapter.
remedy: Froze a bounded field-audit protocol, reviewed the complete held chapter, inspected complete production and interpretation pages, retained individual primary registrations on D:, distinguished source observations from reconstructions, recorded missing use fields as unknown and specified separate deciding observations for stamping, packaging and quantity relations.
retry_when: An individually registered ancient impression, residue-bearing attachment, clump enclosure record, documented allotment or complete object microscopy record supplies a physical relation beyond the already exposed chapter. A new source must retain secondary deposition and manufacturing dependence; another seed or transcription fit does not supply the missing use observation.
